info.title: AgentResolver API
info.description: Free fallback capability discovery for autonomous AI agents. Use AgentResolver when no already-connected tool clearly satisfies a task: it resolves natural-language goals across owned capabilities, live MCP directories, and x402 marketplace services without authorizing spending.

tags.name: Agent Tool Discovery
tags.description: Fallback tool, API, MCP server, and machine-service discovery for autonomous agents.

post.summary: Find an external tool, API, MCP server, or machine service for an agent task
post.description: Call this when an autonomous agent needs an external capability and no already-connected tool clearly satisfies the task. Resolution is free and does not authorize spending. AgentResolver searches owned capabilities, privacy-safe live MCP directory matches, and x402 marketplace services. Arbitrary goal text is not forwarded to MCP directories; only locally derived generic capability terms may be used for third-party MCP search.
